I know poetry is not dead, nor genius lost; nor has Mammon—the god of money—gained power over either, to bind or destroy them: they will both assert their existence, their presence, their freedom and their strength again one day. Mighty angels, safe in heaven! They smile when base souls triumph and timid ones weep over their destruction. Poetry destroyed? Genius banished? No! Mediocrity, no: do not let envy suggest that thought to you. No; they not only survive but reign and redeem: and without their divine influence everywhere, you would live in hell—the hell of your own smallness.
